summary_1line: Sage Vishwamitra asks King Dasaratha to send Rama with him to protect a sacrifice from the demons Maricha and Subahu.

image_candidates.scene_text: Sage Vishwamitra stands before King Dasaratha in the royal court, requesting that the young prince Rama accompany him to defeat the demons.
Two demons, Maricha and Subahu, hurl blood and flesh onto a sacred fire altar while sages look on in horror.
Vishwamitra gestures solemnly as he promises to guide and protect the youthful Rama during the mission.
